data: What is the total size for which the console test takes about 200 minutes?

The question asks for the total size for which the console test takes approximately 200 minutes. From the caption, we can see that the x-axis represents the Total Size in GB, and the y-axis represents Time in Minutes. The red line represents the Console test. By examining the graph, we can observe that when the time on the y-axis reaches approximately 200 minutes, the corresponding value on the x-axis is around 8 GB. Therefore, the total size for which the console test takes about 200 minutes is approximately 8 GB.
